remarks: Stunning, sophisticated, beautifully appointed, first-floor Primary Bedroom Suite end unit Townhouse in Multi-award winning gated community of Palmer Hill. One of a kind, this 3/4 bedroom Townhouse offers a great floorplan/flexibility. Dramatic 2-story living room with French doors to private patio, 2nd floor loft space for office/sitting area, lower level can be family room/bedroom has full bath....Palmer Hill is strategically located on the Old Greenwich/Stamford border and offers 'resort style living with Clubhouse, Private Gym and Yoga room, Outdoor heated pool and spa and fire pit...... Two-car garage and additional designated parking space in mid-riser underground garage. An absolute gem! Perfect in every way!
